items: The fashionable woman likes to wear elegant *dresses.*
*Skirts* can be worn long or short. These days women usually wear very *short skirts.*
There are different kinds of *shirts* in the market. Women sometimes wear *shirts* to look *casual.*
When it is cold people must wear a good *coat* to protect the body from the wind or the snow during winter time.
Boys and girls usually wear *jackets* to go out depending on what the weather report says.
*Sweaters* are useful. You can wear them in any occasion. It’s very elegant to combine the color of the *sweater* with other clothes you have on, that’s to say, with the clothes you are wearing.

items.q: What does a fashion woman wear?
Why do women sometimes wear shirts?
When can you wear a jacket?
Are you well dressed when you are wearing a sweater?

items: *A lady:* What kind of perfume do you have on?

*A lady:* Because I like it very much.
*A girl:* Oh! You can buy it very close to here. In “Mark’s drugstore” exactly.
*A lady:* Thank you. I will buy some.
*A girl:* You are welcome.
*The lady:* Good-bye.

blocks.text: Vanessa is Samantha’s friend. She went to the beauty parlor because she wanted to change the style of her hair. The stylist gave her a new perm on her long hair. When she got home she went to show her mother.

items: *Vanessa:* Mom, what do you think about my new look?
*Her Mother:* WOW, It looks nice!
*Vanessa:* Why don’t you try a new hair style?
*Her Mother:* Oh! no, no, no. I’m happy with the one I have.
*Vanessa:* If I were you, I would.
*Her Mother:* That’s good for you, but remember I’m twice your age and I don’t intend to grow old gracefully.
*Vanessa:* Well, whatever makes you happy.
*Her Mother:* Well honey, I could dye my hair a new color and visit my doctor for a contact lens prescription.
*Vanessa:* Yeah! That’s good mom!
